## Our Mandate
Founded by Jeff Buckley, PhD, CATER (Center for the Advancement of Technology Education Research) is a collaborative community dedicated to understanding how digital tools can transform pedagogical landscapes. Our center operates at the intersection of data science, psychological measurement, and practical classroom implementation.

::: {.section-feature}
## Core Agendas & Activities

We are committed to three pillars of action:

#### Infrastructure Development
Developing robust, reliable research tools, unique methodologies, and validated scales for assessing technology efficacy in diverse educational settings.
